nodes.label: Start
nodes.content:
## Entry Point

This is the AI agent's entry point node.

At the start of every conversation, read `GET /api/brain` and use the node contents as context.
When something changes (new project, new preference, corrected fact), update the relevant node via `PUT /api/nodes/:id`.
Add new nodes with `POST /api/nodes` and link related ones with `POST /api/links`.

nodes.label: User Profile
nodes.content:
## User Profile

Fill this with what you know about the user:
- Language / preferred communication style
- Tech stack and experience level
- Goals and current focus

**Why:** Tailor every response to who is actually asking.

nodes.label: Preferences & Feedback
nodes.content:
## Preferences & Feedback

Record corrections and confirmed approaches here.

Format each entry:
- **Rule:** what to do (or avoid)
- **Why:** the reason the user gave
- **Applies to:** when this kicks in

nodes.label: Projects
nodes.content:
## Active Projects

List ongoing projects here. For each:
- Name & path
- Goal
- Current status
- Key decisions made

nodes.label: References
nodes.content:
## External References

Pointers to external systems — APIs, dashboards, documentation, issue trackers.

Format: `Name — URL or path — what it's for`
